common.verifyYourselfNote: No wallet, no login. Recompute the result from public chain data alone.
common.backendUnreachable: The AURA API is unreachable right now. This is a network issue, not fake data. Try again shortly.
common.builtTested: Built and tested; activates at the mainnet deploy

gate.title: This activates at the mainnet deploy.
gate.body: The game-layer contracts (ArenaVote and AuraFusion) fold into the same mainnet deploy as the ERC-7857 cutover. Until their addresses are wired, the backend returns a 501 for every game action, so this page renders the honest not-yet-armed state instead of fake data. Everything below is built, Foundry-tested, and ready; it goes live the moment the deploy sets the addresses.
gate.whatWorksNowBody: Read the mechanism, copy the exact self-check commands you will run against the live contracts, and (for Fusion) browse the real Auras you own. No result is invented.
gate.statusReading: Checking whether this deploy has the contract wired
gate.sourceOfTruth: This state is read live from the backend (a 501 means the address is empty), exactly like the ERC-7857 claim on the Proof page renders from live contract state.

fuse.title: Fuse two Auras into a descendant.
fuse.lede: Pick two Auras you own. A blind, un-grindable seed derives the child's genome on-chain, both parents persist, and the descendant is born with provable lineage and a rising generation. Fusion, never breeding.
fuse.entryNote: Combine this Aura with another you own to mint a descendant with inherited style and on-chain lineage.

rules.ownBothNote: Fusion is own-both. Cross-owner siring is a post-cup economy.
rules.persistNote: Neither parent is burned. They keep fusing, subject to a per-Aura cooldown.
rules.siblingsNote: Fusing the same pair again yields a different descendant: the per-fusion seed varies, so siblings are not clones. Scarcity is economic (fee, cooldown, generation), not a one-per-pair cap.
rules.feeNote: Each fusion charges a fee and starts a cooldown on both parents, and raises the child's generation.

pick.title: Choose two parent Auras
pick.body: These are the Auras this wallet owns on-chain. Select exactly two.
pick.empty: This wallet does not own two Auras yet. Create or collect Auras first, then come back to fuse them.
pick.needTwo: Select two distinct Auras to continue.
pick.sameParent: A parent cannot fuse with itself. Pick a different second Aura.

review.title: Review the fusion
review.genesisNeeded: One or both parents need a one-time genesis registration (their genome, derived from their on-chain style fingerprint) before they can fuse. This is owner-signed and recomputable by anyone.
review.requestNote: This is the commit step: it locks the pairing to a future block whose hash seeds the child. You cannot grind the outcome.

commit.title: Commit the fusion
commit.body: Your wallet signs requestFusion and sends the fusion fee. The server signs nothing: it only computes the exact call arguments for your wallet (non-custodial).
commit.waiting: Waiting for the target block that seeds the descendant
commit.toReveal: Once the target block is mined, reveal to generate and mint the child.

reveal.title: Reveal the descendant
reveal.body: Your wallet signs executeFusion with the computed child arguments. The child portrait is generated in a 0G TEE, its brain is sealed to your wallet, and the descendant mints with on-chain lineage.
reveal.generating: Generating the descendant in a 0G TEE

child.title: The descendant
child.genomeNote: Eight loci, Mendelian, derived bit-exact from both parents and the un-grindable fuse seed.
child.dynastyNote: The descendant's ancestry, read from on-chain lineage.
child.memoryNote: The descendant inherits a blend of both parents' foundational memory (L1) and starts a fresh relationship memory (L2).
child.verifyBody: Anyone can recompute the descendant's genome from the parents' on-chain genomes and the on-chain fuse seed, then assert it equals the minted child. A hand-picked child is impossible.
child.verifyNote: recompute the child genome from public chain data and assert it equals AuraFusion.genomeOf(childId)

arena.title: Auras battle on art. The crowd decides.
arena.lede: Two Auras render the same secret theme, each in its own style, shown blind. Voters stake a blind, commit-reveal ballot; the winner is a pure function of the on-chain tally, not our database. The tally is anyone's to recompute.

list.title: Battles
list.body: Every battle is a like-for-like style contest on one shared, un-grindable theme.
list.lookupBody: Enter a battle number to load its live on-chain state.
list.none: No battles are live on this deploy yet. Battles are created by the operator once the arena contract is wired at the mainnet deploy.

battle.title: Battle #{id}
battle.themeNote: Both Auras rendered this one subject, derived from the create-battle block hash, so neither side could grind a favourable prompt.
battle.blindNote: Which piece is which Aura stays hidden until the battle finalizes, so you vote on the art, not the name.

vote.title: Cast a blind, staked vote
vote.body: Pick a side and a stake. Your ballot is committed as a hash (blind), then revealed after voting closes. Weight is linear in your stake, so nobody buys a square-root discount.
vote.keepSalt: Store this salt. You need it to reveal. Losing it forfeits part of your stake (a non-reveal).
vote.committedNote: Your ballot is committed and blind. Return in the reveal window to reveal it with the salt above.
vote.nonReveal: Committed but unrevealed ballots forfeit part of their stake and do not count. This kills straddling.

result.title: Result
result.notFinal: The winner is set on finalize, once the reveal window closes.

verify.title: Verify the tally yourself
verify.body: The winner is a deterministic function of the on-chain Revealed events: sum the linear weight per side, take the argmax. A separate process can re-tally from the log alone, with no AURA database in the loop. This is the anti-SQLite-theater proof.
verify.curlNote: the keyless GET /api/arena/tally surface: recompute the winner from public chain data
verify.castNote: read the contract's own enforced tally, then sum the Revealed logs yourself and assert they match
verify.agree: Independent tally must equal the contract's enforced tally
verify.trustRoot: The trust root is the deployed ArenaVote bytecode, not AURA's database.

ladder.title: A rank you can recompute.
ladder.lede: A fixed-point Glicko-1 ladder over the on-chain battle verdicts, anchored by a single Merkle root and re-derivable by anyone. Rank is a reputation signal that feeds price and matchmaking. It never pays an emission.

board.title: Leaderboard
board.body: Agents ranked by conservative rating (rating minus twice the deviation) among rating-eligible Auras.
board.empty: No rated verdicts on this deploy yet. The ladder fills from finalized, rated battles once the arena contract is wired at the mainnet deploy.

badge.provisionalNote: Rating deviation is still too high to rank. Play more rated battles to become eligible.
badge.unratedNote: This Aura has no finalized, rated battle verdicts yet.

signal.title: Rank is a signal, never a reward
signal.body: Rank feeds price, matchmaking, and siring value. There is deliberately no token or emission on rank, because paying rank is the regime that becomes about 90% wash trading.

verify.title: Verify the ladder yourself
verify.body: Recompute the whole ladder from the on-chain verdicts, rebuild the Merkle root, and assert it equals the anchored root. Zero trust in AURA.
verify.curlNote: the keyless GET /api/arena/ladder/verify surface: recompute the ladder and assert its root matches the anchor
verify.note: ladder = fixed-point Glicko-1 over the on-chain rated verdicts; root = OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree of the sorted rows
